components.name: Search Field
components.description: Searches listener ports, processes, and projects; focus shifts the border to signal green.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5"></circle><path d="m13 13 4 4"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search port, process, or project"><kbd>/</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #31536c; border-radius: 9px; background: #0a1b29; color: #f1f3f3; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #1df682; background: #0e2232; } .ds-search svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: #b1c6d8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #b1c6d8; } .ds-search kbd { padding: 1px 5px; border: 1px solid #31536c; border-radius: 5px; color: #b1c6d8; font: 12px Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Rescan Button
components.description: Requests a fresh local listener scan.
components.css: .ds-rescan { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #3c78a4; border-radius: 8px; background: #10283b; color: #f1f3f3; font: 650 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-rescan:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #1df682; background: #15374a; } .ds-rescan:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0ffca; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rescan:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.name: Route Node
components.description: A port, process, or project value inside the connected route field.
components.css: .ds-route-node { display: flex; min-height: 58px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #31536c; border-radius: 9px; background: #0e2232; color: #f1f3f3; } .ds-lamp { width: 11px; height: 11px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 2px solid #91a9bd; border-radius: 50%; background: #0e2232; } .ds-route-node strong, .ds-route-node small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-route-node strong { font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-route-node small { margin-top: 2px; color: #b1c6d8; font: 12px Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Selected Route
components.description: Selectable route row; selected state traces all three ownership steps in green.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e3a52; background: #0e2432; color: #f1f3f3; text-align: left; } .ds-route-node { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #228b59; border-radius: 9px; background: #102a30; } .ds-route .ds-lamp { border-color: #1df682; background: #1df682; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(29 246 130 / 10%); } .ds-arrow { color: #1df682; } .ds-route:hover { background: #0d2130; } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0ffca; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Listening Tag
components.description: Shows the scanner's literal listening protocol beside the selected listener.
components.css: .ds-listening { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #286747; border-radius: 999px; color: #b8ffd7; font: 650 12px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-listening > span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1df682; }

components.name: Terminate Button
components.description: Opens a confirmation for the selected process; never terminates directly.
components.css: .ds-terminate { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #96433e; border-radius: 8px; background: #251b22; color: #ffaaa3; text-align: left; font: 650 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-terminate:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #ff625b; background: #352023; color: #ffd2ce; } .ds-terminate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0ffca; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-terminate:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(460px, calc(100vw - 32px)); padding: 25px; border: 1px solid #31536c; border-radius: 14px; background: #0b1e2c; color: #f1f3f3; box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 52%); font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 400 26px Amaranth, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog p, .ds-dialog dt { color: #b1c6d8; } .ds-dialog dl { margin: 18px 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #1e3a52; border-radius: 8px; background: #0a1b29; } .ds-dialog dl div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(30 58 82 / 70%); } .ds-dialog dl div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-dialog dd { margin: 0; } .ds-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .ds-actions button { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #31536c; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #b1c6d8; font: 650 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-actions .ds-confirm { border-color: #b44c46; background: #a5302d; color: #fff6f3; } .ds-actions .ds-confirm:hover { border-color: #ff625b; background: #c13d38; } .ds-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0ffca; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
PortWatch presents each live TCP listener as a route with a visible owner. Ink-navy surfaces, chalk text, fine blue rules, and aligned data make the board feel like an enamel signal panel built for inspection. The approved route-field composition is the visual center: Port → Process → Project remains one connected reading path.

The interface stays compact and factual. Green marks the selected route and appears alongside the literal listening status; red identifies errors and termination. The product reports local scan results and process details, so visual status never implies availability or health beyond the scanner's reported state. Termination stays a separate action with a confirmation that repeats the process, PID, and port.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink-navy surfaces with chalk text and fine blue dividers.
A connected three-step route field for port ownership.
Compact sans-serif controls and tabular monospace values.
Explicit local connection, listening, and termination states.

rules.name: The Factual Signal Rule
rules.body: Pair colored status with literal text. The board reports a listener as “Listening · TCP”; it does not infer a free port or process health.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Keep port and PID values in the monospace stack with tabular numerals so adjacent records scan consistently.

dos: Do show listener ownership as one Port → Process → Project route.
Do use live scanner data and label unavailable process details explicitly.
Do pair colored status with the literal status text.
Do keep termination behind a confirmation that identifies the selected process, PID, and port.
Do preserve the listener, route, inspector order as the layout stacks.
donts: Don't imply a port is free, healthy, or blocked unless the scanner reports that fact.
Don't turn the workspace into disconnected summary cards or hide the owner relationship.
Don't encode status by color alone.
Don't reduce critical labels or route content below readable sizes when adapting the layout.
